description: Advanced FOSS keyboard with AI Copilot, translation, and key sound synthesis Iris is a privacy-centric, feature-rich keyboard for Android, built on the lightweight foundation of Simple Keyboard. Iris extends typing into a powerful productivity workspace by integrating locally-run AI models, an offline translation suite, mechanical switch sound synthesis, and advanced clipboard tools. Key Features: * AI Copilot Studio: Interact with AI backends (Ollama for local networks, Gemini, or custom OpenAI-compatible endpoints) directly inside your keyboard toolbar. Make text adjustments (Smart Compose, Grammar Fix, Simplify) without switching apps. * Translation Suite: Translate text instantly using offline Google ML Kit models (requires MlKit flavor), web scraping, or custom AI translations. * Synthesized Switch Soundpacks: Low-latency procedural audio engine that generates satisfying typing clacks, including bubble wrap, retro typewriter, Cherry MX switch clicks, or customizable sampled sound packs from remote archives. * Advanced Clipboard Manager: Keeps an organized history of your copied texts with a quick paste chip bar. * Media & Expression: Complete GIF search engine (Tenor, Giphy) and customizable emoji quick bar. * Personalization: Choose geometric key cap shapes (Circle, Squircle, Hexagon, Square), adjust key size scales, change horizontal/vertical key gaps, and set custom key or keyboard-wide background images. * Built-in Themes & AMOLED Black: High contrast themes with key color customizations and battery-saving true black mode. * FOSS & Privacy-First: No trackers, analytics, or background telemetry. Supports Android MDM Managed Configurations for enterprise deployments.
